text: I found this in your room. Where did you get it?
Why, Zoltan, what do you mean?
You know exactly what I mean.
Gaston gave it to you, didn't he?
No. I bought it when we were in London last month.
I'm not a fool, Marie. I've been watching him.
When he looks at you, you smile and blush.
And he's always hovering around you backstage.
But you're wrong, Zoltan. He's just a friend. That's all.
I don't want him here tomorrow night.
But he's your prop man. He has a right to be at your party. Please
Believe me, Zoltan. I love you. Only you.
I want to believe you, Marie.
